description: Open-source package & CVE security scanner for coding agents. Checks npm, PyPI, or Rust crates against Google OSV.dev for known security vulnerabilities, deprecation status, and latest stable version.

payment_signature.description: Optional x402 v2/v1 Base64 or JSON EIP-3009 USDC payment signature to unlock the full unmasked dataset directly via MCP

version.description: Optional specific version to audit (defaults to latest version)

x_api_key.description: Optional ak_live_... 30-day Prepaid API Pass key to unlock the full unmasked dataset

name: package_audit
